findings.title: Item 5b: the queen colour change does nothing in the game, and the report's 'modest visible lift' is false
findings.detail: In the game, AntRenderer passes the species appearance to resolveMorph (variantStore.ts:44, AntRenderer.ts:76). applyAppearance then sets head and mesosoma to appearance.bodyColour and gaster to appearance.gasterColour for every caste. For Lasius these are '#1e1814' and '#1a1512' from src/sim/species/data/lasius-niger.ts:145. So the in-game queen never uses LASIUS_QUEEN.colors: both the old values ('#2a1f1a'...) and the new ones ('#382a22'...) are dead data. Only the appearance-less demo path sees them. Evidence: (1) the implementer's own pictures test-output/app-seams-3/queen-before-{test,medium,high}/0{1,2}-*.png and queen-after-* are pixel-identical (PIL difference bbox None for all 6 pairs, identical byte sizes), so the compare sheets show no change. (2) The new test src/render/ants/morph/queenColours.verify.test.ts fails: with LASIUS_NIGER.appearance, resolveMorph('lasius-niger','queen') returns mesosoma/gaster/head '#1e1814','#1a1512','#1e1814', the same as the worker. The report's diagnosis is also wrong: it says the queen's colours were darker than her workers' (albedo about 0.012), but in the game both render with the same species colours. The spec asked to tune her material if she reads flat and to show before and after; that item is effectively not done, and the acceptance-3 evidence for item 5 shows no change. To fix inside src/render: make the queen lift survive applyAppearance, for example a per-caste lift applied after the appearance in catalog.ts, then re-take before/after at test, medium and high and confirm the pixels differ. Leave the species data in src/sim alone.

findings.title: Item 4: strict stage1a was run only with STAGE1A_SKIP_HIGH=1

The script change looks right: the out-of-phase refusal is now an asserted check, and the stand-in message quotes the real opening's log.

result.summary: Finding 1 was real and is fixed: the species appearance overwrote every caste's body and gaster colours, so the lifted LASIUS_QUEEN colours never reached the game. A morphology can now set ownColours to opt out of that overwrite, and the queen (and the gyne, which inherits it) does. Before and after pictures now differ at all three presets, and I looked at them: a modest warm lift. Finding 2 is closed: the full strict stage1a gate, including the high-quality part, passed. Finding 3 stays a note, since nothing in my paths forwards the sim's new killAll cause. Typecheck is clean in my paths and 243 tests pass in src/render/ants and src/game/save.
